activities.activity: Sleeping in bed with the air conditioner set to a cool temperature for the heatwave night
Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and taking a quick cool shower
Making and eating breakfast with toast from the toaster and tea from the kettle, drinking extra water before the hot day
Dressing in light work clothes and packing a water bottle and personal items for the shift
Commuting to the health care facility for the morning shift
Working as a health care professional, caring for patients, checking vitals, administering treatments and coordinating with the care team
Cooking a light dinner with the induction cooker and eating while staying hydrated
Taking a cool shower to recover from the heat and putting work clothes into the washing machine
Relaxing on the sofa with the air conditioner and fan running, watching TV and browsing the computer
Winding down with the fan on low, setting an alarm on the phone and going to sleep
